steps.caption: Open Market & reports from the More menu.
Market: validated releases only. 'Re-run checks' re-validates the figures.
Descriptive only — not a forecast. Stock is never summed and no vacancy is guessed.
Each series names its measure, area and unit — here absorption in msf, per year.
Below each chart: period, unit and source with its release date. Missing years stay unknown.
Network: job moves, who knows whom, introduction paths and deal gaps.
Recent job moves are unverified until you confirm them.
Legal: for LOIs, term sheets and leases — for the tenant's lawyers, not legal advice.
Upload a PDF or Word file; add a later version with the same family key to get a redline.
Link it to a lease so Leases (and its Radar tab) can use its clauses (notice dates, break options).
Content: LinkedIn posts and market notes in your voice. You publish them yourself.
'Plan this week' suggests two post ideas and a market-note slot (it also runs every Monday).
Drafts are checked against the evidence and confidentiality rules before they can be approved.
Reports: approaches, discussions and deals by month — descriptive, not predictions.
Targets are your planning assumptions. Drafts and follow-ups never count as approaches.
Cohort funnel: what happened to the approaches started each month.
Stage conversion: how many deals are at each stage, from research to collected.
Time to stage: how many days deals take to reach each step.
